_meta.scope: Book-wide prop library (Phase 4): every hand-held object, weapon-free, that the source text gives a character to use, carry, hand over or point at. Plot props carry the scale triple and concept images; minor mentions sit in non_plot_inventory. Set pieces built into a scene (glass table, the rose-tree, the Caterpillar's mushroom as a set build, the tea-table) are owned by 05-scenes environment/architecture and only cross-referenced here.
_meta.content_language: English (project UI language = English, so scale.prompt_token and visual are English and are injected verbatim downstream)
inputs_read: story/episodes/ep01/screenplay.md (S01 thick book; S03 ORANGE MARMALADE jar; S04 large watch; S06 little glass box under the table for the EAT ME cake; S08 gloves and large fan)
bible/style.json v1.1.0 (BIB-0027): style_fragment_ui, negative_prompt_en, negative_prompt_waking_addon_en, CR-002, CR-005, CR-010, CR-012, user_refs
bible/costumes.json (hand props owned by 06-art/prop; King's crown worn state = gold crown set with a red heart)
bible/scenes/*/environment.json + architecture.json (mushroom set build x9, tea-table dressing, W. RABBIT plate)
bible/characters/CHAR-white-rabbit/appearance.json (about a foot high reared: sizes his watch, gloves, fan and trumpet)
bible/cultivation.json SUP-003, SUP-009, SUP-012, SUP-014; bible/changelog.md BIB-0027; qa/defects/DEF-p4-style-001.json
refs/style/alice.jpeg (look reference: verdigris-bronze narghile with a long purple-grey hose beside the mushroom; refs/props/ empty)
shared_rules: Period lock (CR-002): every prop is an 1862 English object, also inside Art Nouveau dream sets; props carry no Mucha ornament of their own unless noted.

Lettering (CR-012): legible in-world lettering only on the DRINK ME label, the EAT ME currants and the ORANGE MARMALADE label. Every other readable face (book pages, letter, scroll, slates, note-book, verses) shows handwriting or type too small, faded or blurred to read.
No execution device, weapon or blade near a body (CR-010). The soldiers' clubs are processional card-suit batons carried upright and never raised.

Scale (CR-005, SUP-003): sizes below are the prop's true size against the character who normally handles it. Alice's size changes are staged with oversized or miniature duplicate builds of the same design; a duplicate never changes the design, only the build scale.
scale.prompt_token is the single canonical wording, injected verbatim by 08-video-gen/prompt; canonical_size is for human review and visual-qa only and never goes into a prompt.

Images: main_01.png = form/material close-up (for readable_face props, a two-view sheet with the panels labelled 'FRONT' / 'BACK'); scale_ref_01.png = prop with non-human everyday objects. No person or body part in any prop image; no character/costume art is ever passed as --ref.
_meta.readable_face_rule: Readable-face direction is decided per shot by 08-video-gen/prompt; this file only flags the props and describes both faces. back_ref points at main_01.png (the two-view sheet). When prompting with it, add the single-instance sentence from the prompt SOUL (one object, the sheet shows two views of it).
